probes.name: sheet_name_00
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Name = ""
Probe = Err.Number & "|" & (ws.Name = "")
End Function

probes.name: range_call_one
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
Probe = ws.Range("B2:C3")(1).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B2:C3")(4).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B2:C3")(5).Address
End Function

End Function

probes.name: range_call_value
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("B2").Value = 7
Dim x As Variant
x = ws.Range("B2:C3")(1)
Probe = TypeName(x) & "|" & x
End Function

probes.name: cells_call
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
Probe = ws.Cells(2, 2)(2).Address & "|" & ws.Cells(1)(3).Address
End Function

probes.name: cells_item_index
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
Probe = ws.Range("B2:C3").Cells(2, 2).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B2:C3").Cells(3).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B2:C3")(1).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B2:C3").Item(2, 1).Address
End Function
